description: Three-panel composite XRD figure for the spark-plasma-sintered (SPSed) Fe40Mn19Ni15Al15Si10C1 high-entropy steel. (a) Full XRD pattern, x-axis 2θ (Degree) spanning 30-100°, y-axis Intensity (a.u.), with a marker legend: red filled marker = BCC, open diamond = B2-type, green filled marker = Fe5Si3-type, blue club marker = γ-brass type. Printed reflection indices include BCC (110) on the tallest peak (which falls inside the 51-54° window of panel b), a red BCC (200) near 78° and (211) at the right edge, open-diamond B2 (100) near 35°, B2 (110) near 54° and B2 (211) at high angle, plus green Fe5Si3-type (210), (211) and (112) reflections. (b) is an inset deconvolution of the 51-54° 2θ range (y-axis Intensity (a.u.)), resolving the measured black profile into three fitted components coloured red (BCC), blue (B2-type) and green (Fe5Si3-type). (c) is the Rietveld refinement over 2θ ≈ 10-100° with Obs (blue), Calc (green), Bkg (red), Zero (black) and Diff (cyan) curves plus four rows of colour-coded Bragg tick marks for BCC, B2-type, γ-brass type and Fe5Si3-type. The figure establishes BCC ferrite as the major phase with partially ordered B2 and trace γ-brass and Fe5Si3-type intermetallics.

subfigures.description: Powder XRD pattern of the SPSed sample, 2θ = 30-100° (Degree), Intensity (a.u.), with a marker legend assigning red = BCC, open diamond = B2-type, green = Fe5Si3-type and blue club = γ-brass type. Peak indices (100), (110), (210), (110), (211), (112), (200), (211) are printed beside the peaks; the tallest reflection is the red BCC (110).

Inset deconvolution of the 51-54° 2θ range (Intensity (a.u.)) in which the measured black profile is fitted by three overlapping peaks coloured red (BCC), blue (B2-type) and green (Fe5Si3-type), whose maxima occur at slightly different 2θ positions within the window.

Rietveld refinement plot, 2θ ≈ 10-100° with ticks at 20, 40, 60, 80, 100; the legend lists Obs (blue), Calc (green), Bkg (red), Zero (black) and Diff (cyan), and four rows of Bragg-position tick marks are labelled BCC (blue), B2-type (red), γ-brass type (green) and Fe5Si3-type (cyan). The difference curve is essentially flat, indicating a good fit.

observations.observation: Panel (a) legend assigns the marker symbols as follows: red marker = BCC, open diamond = B2-type, green marker = Fe5Si3-type, blue club = γ-brass type.
The tallest reflection in panel (a) is labelled (110) of BCC, and it lies inside the 51-54° window that panel (b) deconvolutes.
Panel (a) prints the reflection indices (100), (110), (210), (211), (112), (200) and (211) beside individual peaks across the 30-100° 2θ range.
Panel (b) resolves the 51-54° region into three overlapping fitted components coloured red (BCC), blue (B2-type) and green (Fe5Si3-type) overlaid on a black measured profile.
Panel (c) shows observed, calculated, background, zero-line and difference curves of a Rietveld refinement, with the difference curve nearly flat.
Panel (c) displays four rows of Bragg-position tick marks colour-coded for BCC (blue), B2-type (red), γ-brass type (green) and Fe5Si3-type (cyan), the cyan Fe5Si3 row containing the most reflections.
The caption states the SPSed sample is a ferritic (BCC) high entropy steel containing B2, γ-brass type and Fe5Si3 type intermetallics.

The caption states panel (b) deconvolutes the range 51°-54°, whereas the citing sentence describes the same deconvolution as covering 51°-56°; the printed axis of panel (b) reads 51 to 54, agreeing with the caption.
The citing text states the BCC (ferrite) phase is the major phase with partially ordered B2 and trace amounts of γ-brass type and Fe Si type phase.

The citing text states that lattice parameter, crystallite size and phase fraction of the SPSed sample were determined by Rietveld refinement and are reported in Table 4, which is not part of this figure.
No numeric intensity values are printed on any of the three panels; both y-axes are given only as Intensity (a.u.).

measured_quantities: phase fraction (from Rietveld refinement, reported in Table 4)
unreadable_items: panel (c): y-axis carries no numerical tick labels, only 'Intensity (a.u.)'
panel (b): exact 2θ positions of the three fitted component maxima are not printed
panel (a): peak labels are small and a few index assignments (e.g. the open-diamond and blue-club peaks between 60-95°) are only partially readable
